content:
**The tier decides the exit code, in one place (#603)**

GitLab lite consumers were blocked by memory-gate and phase-order, which GATE_MATRIX resolves to detection. Root cause was NOT the YAML: run-check.mjs (entrypoint for memory-gate, decision-gate, issue-link, diff-size) never called mapDetectionToWarning, while phase-order-check.mjs and actor-check.mjs did. Fixed in main() so both providers get one answer from one implementation; allow_failure in the fragment would have been a second declaration of what GATE_MATRIX owns. Measured after: lite -> exit 0 with ::warning:: naming gate and tier; standard -> exit 1. Also made openspec/specs/governance provider-neutral over SCAFFOLD_DELIVERY, and the fragment header now says where the tier is resolved so nobody hunts for allow_failure.
